'''Cael Hanarist''' was an [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] from [[House Hanarist]]. He served on [[Team Alderaan]], the [[Limmie/Legends|Limmie]] group and was one of the fastest players in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. He had a [[Cael's fiancée|fiancee]] from another House. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] was [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroyed]], causing him to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] as a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|Alliance Special Operations]]. He took part in the [[takeover at Whisper Base]] and then defended it from Moff [[Lasre Dardano]]'s [[Battle of Whisper Base|counterattack]].

His Team Alderaan jersey hung in an Alderaanian expat [[cantina]] in [[Hanna City/Legends|Hanna City]], [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]].

==Behind the scenes==
Cael Hanarist appears in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2014]] [[roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Beginner Game]]''.
